claims.summary: Arabian Nights 1993-12-17, credited artist Anson Maddocks.

The Efreet deals one damage to its controller at the beginning of that player's upkeep, and attacks for three flying combat damage if it has been under its controller's control since the start of their turn. Its Revised Edition green frame and alternate illustration were a printing error, not a change of color identity. With the Efreet already controlled at the beginning of the turn, its one-damage upkeep trigger moves its controller from five to four life, then a legal attack deals three to an unblocked opponent. Its triggered self-damage still matters in games decided by racing.
The 2015 Old School American Weenie archive credits Brian Fisher and includes the Efreet, providing an era-specific deck-pool reference without attributing a specific match or board state.
